def extract_year(value, epoch):
    """Return a year from an Excel date/datetime/string/serial, or None."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.year
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.year
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        try:
            return from_excel(value, epoch=epoch).year
        except Exception:
            return None
    if isinstance(value, str):
        text = value.strip()
        if not text:
            return None
        # Prefer a 4-digit year if present.
        m = re.search(r"\b(19\d{2}|20\d{2}|21\d{2})\b", text)
        if m:
            return int(m.group(1))
        # Try common date parsing via datetime formats.
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d", "%d-%m-%Y", "%m-%d-%Y"):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).year
            except Exception:
                pass
    return None

def parse_header_year(value, previous_year=None):
    """Parse year headers in G1:K1, with a fallback for a malformed final year such as 221 after 2020."""
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.year
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.year
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        n = int(value)
        if 1000 <= n <= 9999:
            return n
        if previous_year is not None and 1900 <= previous_year + 1 <= 9999:
            return previous_year + 1
        return n
    if isinstance(value, str):
        text = value.strip()
        m = re.search(r"(19\d{2}|20\d{2}|21\d{2})", text)
        if m:
            return int(m.group(1))
        if previous_year is not None:
            return previous_year + 1
        try:
            return int(float(text))
        except Exception:
            return None
    if previous_year is not None:
        return previous_year + 1
    return None

# Build year -> set of unique project IDs from columns B(Project ID) and C(Shipped), rows 2 onward.
projects_by_year = {}
for r in range(2, ws_values.max_row + 1):
    project_id = ws_values.cell(r, 2).value
    if project_id is None or project_id == "":
        continue
    shipped_value = ws_values.cell(r, 3).value
    yr = extract_year(shipped_value, wb_values.epoch)
    if yr is None:
        # Fallback to non-data_only cell if needed
        yr = extract_year(ws.cell(r, 3).value, wb.epoch)
    if yr is None:
        continue
    projects_by_year.setdefault(yr, set()).add(project_id)

# Fill only G2:K2 with the number of unique projects for each header year.
previous_year = None
for col in range(7, 12):  # G:K
    header_value = ws_values.cell(1, col).value
    year = parse_header_year(header_value, previous_year)
    previous_year = year if year is not None else previous_year
    ws.cell(2, col).value = len(projects_by_year.get(year, set())) if year is not None else 0

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
